name: Beyond the Boundary
source:
A young man, holds dear to his family
Another young man, basking in innocence
A mysterious shop that grants wishes
And a story that started it all

When a person tried to change fate
Which one will he choose?

Do you believe in strange phenomenas?
Do you have any wish to be granted?
Are you willing to pay the price?

Welcome to Beyond The Boundary.

[From [url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=28006]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]
translation:
一个珍视家人的年轻人，
一个沉浸于纯真的年轻人，
一家能够实现愿望的神秘商店，
以及一段由此开始的故事。

当有人试图改变命运时，
他会选择哪一条路？

你相信奇怪的现象吗？
你有想要实现的愿望吗？
你愿意付出代价吗？

欢迎来到《边界之外》。

[译自[url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=28006]Lemma Soft论坛[/url]]
